title: Cloud
unavailable: Cloud isn't available in this session: its engine (lordos-rclone) isn't installed or isn't running.

freedSkipped.one: {size} freed; {count} item stays (open, kept or waiting to go up)
freedSkipped.other: {size} freed; {count} items stay (open, kept or waiting to go up)

freeBelow: Free up space when this computer has less than
empty.title: Your cloud storage, in Files
empty.body: Add a drive, a server or a bucket. Its files show in Files under Cloud and come down when you open them.
service.title: Service
service.private: only LordOS can reach it, on no network address
bandwidthHint: Cloud's transfers run at low priority, so they never slow down the desktop.
about.title: About rclone
about.license: MIT License, the same as LordOS
about.hint: rclone is the open source engine LordOS uses for Cloud. It runs for you alone and listens on no network address.
space.title: Space
space.noQuota: This storage has no quota: what is used is measured once a day.
space.emptyTrash: Empty the trash on the website
state.signin: Sign in again to keep syncing
menu.onlyOn: Show the recent files of {name} (click other accounts to add them)
menu.onlyOff: Stop showing only the recent files of {name}
menu.noRecent: Nothing recent in the chosen accounts.
share.anyone: Anyone with the link can view it
share.provider: To share with specific people, set a password or let them edit, use Open on Website: those options are the provider's.
link.unsupported: This storage has no public links. Open on Website shares it there.
link.failed: The link couldn't be made. Try again in a moment.
links.title: Shared links
offline.title: {name} isn't on this computer
offline.body: The cloud can't be reached right now. It opens once the network is back, or keep it on this computer next time.
notify.signinTitle: “{name}” needs you to sign in again
notify.signinBody: The provider stopped accepting the saved sign-in. Changes made here wait on this computer until you sign in. Files you kept still open.
notify.conflictBody: {file} also changed in {account}. Your version kept its name; the other one is next to it as “{kept}”.

notify.fullBody.one: {used} of {total} used. {count} changed file can't go up. Free space in the account or choose files to keep only on this computer.
notify.fullBody.other: {used} of {total} used. {count} changed files can't go up. Free space in the account or choose files to keep only on this computer.

addFolderTitle: Keep a folder of “{name}” on this computer
inKeyring: Its sign-in is in the keyring
removeHint: Removing it deletes nothing in the cloud: only its copy on this computer and its sign-in.

removePending.one: {count} change made here hasn't gone up yet. Removing the account now loses it.
removePending.other: {count} changes made here haven't gone up yet. Removing the account now loses them.

ownClient.title: Use my own client ID
ownClient.hint: Sign in with an app you registered with the provider. Its ID and secret go to the keyring.
add.title: Add a Cloud Account
add.subtitle: Its files show in Files under Cloud. Passwords and sign-ins stay in the keyring.
name.chars: A name can't have “/”, “\” or start with a dot.
cred.noteServer: Its password goes to the keyring, never to a file.
cred.noteObject: Keys go to the keyring. Object storage has no quota: Settings shows what is used, measured once a day.
cred.noteCrypt: Names and contents are encrypted on this computer before they go up. Without the password, nobody can read them, LordOS included.
signin.title: Sign in to {provider} in your browser
signin.body: The sign-in page opened in your default browser. When you allow access there, “{name}” appears in Files under Cloud.
signin.expired: The time to sign in ran out.
signin.rclone: Signing in uses rclone, the open source engine LordOS uses for Cloud. The provider's page will ask you to allow rclone.
signin.local: LordOS waits for the page's answer on this computer only (127.0.0.1), and only during the sign-in.
readyBody: Files come down when you open them.
unverified.title: Not verified yet
unverified.line: These work through rclone, but nobody has confirmed them on LordOS yet. Using one? Check it and tell us, and we'll mark it verified.
again.title: Sign in to “{name}” again
ownApp.title: How to sign in
ownApp.needId: Enter your app's client ID, or sign in with rclone's app.
ownApp.inUse: This account signs in with your own app. Sign in again to change it.
check.title: Check This Account
check.hint: Nobody has confirmed this provider on LordOS yet. The check makes a small hidden folder, sends 1 MiB up, brings it back and deletes it. Then you can send us the report.
check.hintVerified: If something doesn't work with this account, the check shows where, and the report helps us fix it.
check.note.noLinks: Not offered by this provider, not a failure
check.note.noSpaceInfo: This provider doesn't tell, not a failure
check.note.notReached: Not run: an earlier step failed
check.note.kept: Kept on this computer, so not freed: not a failure
check.works.no: This account doesn't work as it should
check.private: The report has no account name, email, file names, links or passwords.
check.noBrowser: No web browser opened the page. The report is copied: open github.com/lordbasex/LordOS/issues in a browser and paste it into a new Cloud provider report.
add.loadFailed: rclone didn't answer with its providers.
notes.iclouddrive.password: Use the account's regular password, not an app-specific password: rclone doesn't accept those for this drive.
notes.iclouddrive.adp: The account's extra end-to-end encryption for the drive must be off: rclone can't read files encrypted that way.
notes.iclouddrive.web: Access to the drive from the web must be on in the account's settings.
notes.iclouddrive.code: It asks for a code from one of your devices now, and again about every 30 days (Sign In Again).
question.title: {provider} asks
trash.title: Empty the trash of “{name}”?
trash.detail: Everything in {provider}'s trash for this account is deleted for good. It can't be undone.
measure.hint: This storage has no quota. Measuring lists every file once.
delete.toTrash: It goes to its trash on {provider}.
delete.final: {provider} has no trash: it can't be undone.
ownApp.rcloneLine: Quickest. {provider}'s page will ask you to allow rclone, the open source engine Cloud uses.
ownApp.ownLine: Your own app on {provider}'s developer site: its quota is yours alone. You'll need its client ID and secret.
unlockWhy: Your sign-ins are kept in the keyring, which locks when you log in without a password.
space.notConnected: The space shows once the account is connected.
sftp.keyHint: A private key file, usually in ~/.ssh. What it holds goes to the keyring; the file itself isn't needed afterwards.
sftp.notKey: That file isn't a private key.
trust.hostBody: This is the first connection to {host}. Compare the fingerprint below with the one the server's administrator gives you, and trust it only if they match.
trust.certTitle: This server's certificate isn't trusted by the system
trust.certBody: LordOS couldn't confirm who {host} is. Trust this certificate only if its fingerprint matches the one the server's administrator gives you.
trust.subject: Issued to
state.serviceDown: Not connected: the cloud service isn't running
serviceDown.title: The cloud service isn't running
serviceDown.body: Your accounts aren't connected until it runs again.
trust.changedBody: {host} now shows a different key from the one this account trusted. That happens when the server is reinstalled, but it can also mean another computer is posing as it. Trust the new key only if the server's administrator confirms its fingerprint.
cred.noteSftp: The first time, LordOS shows the server's key fingerprint to compare with its administrator's. Passwords and keys go to the keyring.

search.partial.one: Search stopped early: showing the first {count}
search.partial.other: Search stopped early: showing the first {count}

trust.others.one: Also use the new key for my other account on this server ({count})
trust.others.other: Also use the new key for my other accounts on this server ({count})

cred.keptInKeyring: Saved in the keyring (leave empty to keep it)
opt.pausedOther: Paused for every account (Pause All, battery or a metered network); this switch is for this account alone
check.notReady: The account isn’t working right now (paused, waiting for a sign-in, or with an error). Fix that first, then check it.
check.notReadyPausedAll: Every account is paused (Pause All). Resume to check this one.
check.notReadyPaused: This account is paused. Resume it to check it.
check.notReadySignin: This account needs a new sign-in (Sign In Again) before it can be checked.
use.title: How do you want to use this account?
use.cloudOnlyHint: You see all your files. A file comes down only when you open it, and what you copy in goes up. Nothing is kept on this computer.
use.syncHint: A whole copy here and in the cloud. What you delete on one side is deleted on the other; the provider’s trash keeps it. It takes the account’s space on this computer.
use.later: You can change it later on the account’s page.
